description: Line 20-24 asserts as a 'verified 2026-07-03' fact that Anicca is 'first on (b) public real-time P&L and (d) profit redistributed to humans as UBI.' The spec's own section 7 (line 160-161) states the opposite ground truth: 'verified external income across ALL instances = $0' and '~/.anicca-founder/STATE.md falsely says EARNING -> must be corrected to $0.' With $0 verified profit there is no profit to redistribute, so the 'first on (d) UBI redistribution' claim is unsupported by the spec's own data. A design spec must not present an unearned marketing claim as verified fact while its own body documents $0.

evidence.snippet: Anicca is first on (b) and (d) ... [vs] Current truth: verified external income across ALL instances = $0
